# Vendored libraries

Copied unchanged from their CDN builds, so the demo does not depend on third-party hosts at runtime. The version is part of each file name,
so a new version gets a new URL.

| File | Library | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `codejar-4.2.0.js` | [CodeJar](https://github.com/antonmedv/codejar) 4.2.0 | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/codejar@4.2.0/dist/codejar.js` | MIT |
| `highlight-11.9.0.min.js` | [highlight.js](https://highlightjs.org/) 11.9.0 | `https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/highlight.js/11.9.0/highlight.min.js` | BSD-3-Clause |
| `interact-1.10.27.min.js` | [interact.js](https://interactjs.io/) 1.10.27 | `https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/interact.js/1.10.27/interact.min.js` | MIT |
| `react-18.3.1.min.js` | [React](https://react.dev/) 18.3.1 | `https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/react/18.3.1/umd/react.production.min.js` | MIT |
| `react-dom-18.3.1.min.js` | [React DOM](https://react.dev/) 18.3.1 | `https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/react-dom/18.3.1/umd/react-dom.production.min.js` | MIT |
| `htm-3.1.1.js` | [htm](https://github.com/developit/htm) 3.1.1 | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/htm@3.1.1/dist/htm.module.js` | Apache-2.0 |
